publishedDeadlines.note: Recurring date without stated entry year.

english.toefl: 105 legacy, speaking 26–30; departmental new-scale value not stated
english.note: Program explicitly requires IELTS greater than 8.0 or DET higher than 135 (strict inequalities; no rounded numeric minimum inferred). Official scores within two years sent by application deadline; if received valid, expiry before entry does not invalidate admission proof. No MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Citizenship/degree from listed countries or US permanent-resident/asylee/refugee status over one year may exempt; overseas English-medium instruction alone does not. Higher program minima control; TA and writing assessments separate.

applicationFee.note: International 70 USD; US 60 USD. Conditional recruitment-code or preapproved departmental payment routes; international eligibility should be confirmed. Economic-disadvantage, FreeApp and SROP categories exclude international applicants. Waiver approved or fee paid before admission; one per year and no refund after payment.

documents: Statement of intent: biochemistry motivation, research impact/interests, faculty fit, goals, activities and any academic anomalies
Upload official transcripts from all institutions
requirements.note: Minimum three different 7-week rotations; join lab in mid-spring. Letters may arrive after deadline but no review until complete. International applicants abroad interview remotely; visitations February, most decisions mid-March, acceptance dueApril 15.

funding.note: All admitted OSBP students guaranteed support with satisfactory standing/progress: full tuition, academic fees, health insurance and stipend; first year GRA/fellowship then advisor. Funding page lists historical 2023–24 stipend 32,352 USD/year, not current rate.
